g.text: EXPANDER (section 8.2). U5 TCA9539: every pin is an input while RESET is low, which is whenever no

g.desc: EXPANDER (section 8.2). U5 TCA9539: every pin is an input while RESET is low, which is whenever no

g.text: valve runs. A valve is on when its bit is an output and low: P00 to P03 Z1 to Z4, P04 MV, P10 to P13

g.desc: valve runs. A valve is on when its bit is an output and low: P00 to P03 Z1 to Z4, P04 MV, P10 to P13

g.text: Z5 to Z8. P05 RLY_ON is on when high. P14 reads the build variant, P15 the sensor supply fault.

g.desc: Z5 to Z8. P05 RLY_ON is on when high. P14 reads the build variant, P15 the sensor supply fault.

g.text: RN1, RN2, R96 hold the valve pins at V_DRV, not 3V3, so an off opto LED never sees reverse voltage.

g.desc: RN1, RN2, R96 hold the valve pins at V_DRV, not 3V3, so an off opto LED never sees reverse voltage.

g.text: RN3 holds the four spare pins low. RN2 is fitted on both builds.

g.desc: RN3 holds the four spare pins low. RN2 is fitted on both builds.

g.text: Not fitted: bit P14 reads high,

g.desc: Not fitted: bit P14 reads high,

g.text: Defined levels on every expander pin while it is in reset

g.desc: Defined levels on every expander pin while it is in reset

g.text: K1 G5NB-1A-E, 5 V 125R coil fed from V_BUCK, feeds AC_L to the COM terminals. With K1 open no valve

g.desc: K1 G5NB-1A-E, 5 V 125R coil fed from V_BUCK, feeds AC_L to the COM terminals. With K1 open no valve

g.text: has power, whatever a shorted triac, TVS or opto-triac does. It closes only when Q1 AND Q2 conduct.

g.desc: has power, whatever a shorted triac, TVS or opto-triac does. It closes only when Q1 AND Q2 conduct.

g.text: Q1: on while expander bit RLY_ON is high. DRV_EN low resets the expander and R12 turns Q1 off in 0.1 ms.

g.desc: Q1: on while expander bit RLY_ON is high. DRV_EN low resets the expander and R12 turns Q1 off in 0.1 ms.

g.text: Q2: on while the relay detector sees edges on KA. R89, C51, D22 pump the reservoir C50; R14 and R90

g.desc: Q2: on while the relay detector sees edges on KA. R89, C51, D22 pump the reservoir C50; R14 and R90

g.text: (two, so that one open resistor only doubles the time) drain it. Gate about 2.7 V while toggling.

g.desc: (two, so that one open resistor only doubles the time) drain it. Gate about 2.7 V while toggling.

g.text: Q2 lets go 0.12 to 0.95 s after the last edge, within 1.4 s if the pin stops high.

g.desc: Q2 lets go 0.12 to 0.95 s after the last edge, within 1.4 s if the pin stops high.

g.text: R93, R94, R95: read-back of the node between Q1 and Q2 on GPIO7. 3.05 V = Q2 off, 0 V = Q2 on.

g.desc: R93, R94, R95: read-back of the node between Q1 and Q2 on GPIO7. 3.05 V = Q2 off, 0 V = Q2 on.

g.text: D23 SMBJ48CA clamps COM while K1 is open and takes the inductive kick when it opens under load.

g.desc: D23 SMBJ48CA clamps COM while K1 is open and takes the inductive kick when it opens under load.

g.text: JP1: open. Bridge only if the relay is not fitted (then the fault analysis of section 8.5 is void).

g.desc: JP1: open. Bridge only if the relay is not fitted (then the fault analysis of section 8.5 is void).

g.text: LAYOUT: no test pad on RLY_G2, KB_N1 or KB_N0. Surround the gate node of Q2 with ground: a leakage

g.desc: LAYOUT: no test pad on RLY_G2, KB_N1 or KB_N0. Surround the gate node of Q2 with ground: a leakage

g.text: path from any rail to that node is the only way to hold Q2 on. Keep this pump (R89, C51, D22) at

g.desc: path from any rail to that node is the only way to hold Q2 on. Keep this pump (R89, C51, D22) at

g.text: least 10 mm from the gate-drive pump (R29, C22, D7), and turn C51 at right angles to C22.

g.desc: least 10 mm from the gate-drive pump (R29, C22, D7), and turn C51 at right angles to C22.

g.text: K1 is through-hole, inserted from the bottom side.

g.desc: K1 is through-hole, inserted from the bottom side.

g.text: 16-bit I2C expander, address 0x74, held in reset by DRV_EN

g.desc: 16-bit I2C expander, address 0x74, held in reset by DRV_EN

g.text: Valve-common relay: coil current passes Q1 and Q2 in series

g.desc: Valve-common relay: coil current passes Q1 and Q2 in series
